messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduling Dedicated rollout for customer 'Lighthouse' — planned start 2026-05-10 01:55 UTC. Targets: slice-7..slice-11, canary=slice-7, stagger=10m. Runtime pinned: v2.3.1-inference. Fallback: v2.3.0-hotfix. Preflight: dry-run enabled. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-05/lighthouse-v2.3.1

maya: FYI customer told us they'll rotate KMS keys ~02:30 UTC. Could overlap with later slices. @sre-oncall please assess collision risk.

chris: They said rotation is staged across endpoints over ~5-10m. We've seen short 401s during similar ops. Not show-stopping but could trip a canary.

prod-ops: Proposal: add a kms-auth health gate that requires 5 consecutive successful probes before advancing. Also a 2-retry short backoff on first flake. Config snippet: ```
rollout:
  canary: slice-7
  stagger_minutes: 10
  health_gates:
    - name: kms-auth
      type: http_probe
      path: /internal/health/kms-auth
      success_threshold: 5
      interval_seconds: 10
      retry_attempts: 2
      retry_backoff_seconds: 30
      alert_channel: #eng-oncall
```

kim: +1. Also recommend automatic pause -> manual resume. If paused for >30m escalate to @release-emergency and page SRE.

sre-oncall: I'll be oncall 01:40-03:10. I can watch auth logs and SLOs. My plan: if auth flapping >5% over a 5m window -> pause rollout. If it persists after retries -> rollback canary.

eli: Clarify rollback behavior: do we revert slice-7 back to fallback or just drain and hold? Need explicit rollback trigger and actions in runbook.

jordan: Suggested rollback triggers (canary): any of the following -> immediate rollback of canary slice and abort further slices:
- >=5% auth failures or 5xx over 5 minutes
- latency > 3x baseline for 3 probes
- golden-prompt regression: >=2 failing prompts
Actions: drain KV cache, revert runtime to fallback (v2.3.0-hotfix), run post-rollback smoke tests, notify account + AM.

chris: Make sure revert includes KV-cache drain to avoid inconsistent state. Also run a smoke set (minimal prompts) after revert.

maya: Add manual override channel: @release-emergency (for legal/ops requests). Also confirm golden prompt eval runs inside customer's VPC and only posts a pass/fail summary to deploy-bot (no egress).

prod-ops: Confirmed: golden prompts execute in-slice inside VPC; only aggregated boolean posts. Saved rollout config: /runbooks/releases/lighthouse-2026-05-10.json. Preflight dry-run scheduled at 01:45 UTC (smoke + golden prompts).

deploy-bot: Preflight queued. Actual deploy command (queued):
```
deploybot run --customer lighthouse --slices slice-7..slice-11 --canary slice-7 --stagger 10m --config /runbooks/releases/lighthouse-2026-05-10.json
```

maya: Can we nudge start to 01:50 for extra headroom? If customer isn't comfortable, keep 01:55 but prefer earlier. @prod-ops?

prod-ops: Prefer not to change customer's approved window without sign-off. Alternate: keep 01:55 + preflight at 01:45, enable verbose KMS auth logs 01:40-03:10, and set the 30m pause/escalation policy. We'll notify the customer of the monitoring plan.

sre-oncall: OK I'll monitor dashboards + verbose logs. If I see auth flapping > threshold I'll pause and post status here.

eli: One last check: are rollback and drain steps automated? Want to avoid manual errors if we need to revert under pressure.

jordan: Rollback path will be automated for canary: detect -> trigger drain -> revert to fallback -> run smoke suite -> abort further slices -> post status to thread and notify @release-emergency. Manual intervention available if automation fails.

kim: I'll hold the rollback playbook and postmortem template ready. If we abort, plan: revert -> smoke -> create incident ticket -> AM notified -> postmortem.

maya: Final go/no-go checklist:
- runtime pinned: v2.3.1-inference; fallback: v2.3.0-hotfix ✅
- preflight dry-run at 01:45 UTC ✅
- kms-auth health gate: 5 consecutive successes + 2 retries before pause ✅
- rollback triggers and automated drain/revert defined ✅
- verbose KMS auth logs + SRE coverage 01:40-03:10 ✅
- customer notified and acknowledged ✅
- release-emergency paging configured ✅

prod-ops: I'll send the confirmation email to customer now and enable the verbose logging window.

deploy-bot: Preflight will run at 01:45 UTC and will post results here. Will ping @release-emergency on pause/escalation.

maya: Thanks all — preflight in ~10m. Be on pager. :rocket:
